page.title: Branding
page.subtitle: Logo, colors, and document-letterhead identity for PDFs
page.subtitleForSchool: Branding for {{schoolName}} — appears on invoices, receipts, and other PDF documents

form.saveSuccess: Branding updated. Future PDF documents will use the new settings.
form.saveError: We couldn't save your branding changes. Please try again.
form.addressLinesPlaceholder: One address line per row (max 4 lines)
form.addressLinesHelper: Up to 4 lines, each at most 120 characters. Appears on the letterhead.
form.colorsHelper: Both primary and accent are required when a palette is set. Use 6-digit hex (e.g. #1F4E79). Leave both empty to use defaults.
form.assetsHelper: Upload your school's branding assets. Files upload immediately; click Save to apply.

upload.letterheadGuidance: Design for A4 portrait (210×297mm). Keep the center ~150mm clean — that is where invoice + receipt content sits. When a letterhead is set, the school name + logo from your branding settings are not added by the renderer; the letterhead provides them.

empty.title: No branding configured yet
empty.description: PDF documents will use default styling. Configure branding to add your school's logo, colors, and identity to receipts and invoices.

forbidden.title: Permission required
forbidden.description: Branding settings are managed by Principals and Tenant Admins. Ask your administrator if you need access.

noActiveSchool: Select a school to view its branding.
